resource: Database latency of one item-use commit
allocation_impact: Qualification budget, not a runtime cutoff. Far below ITEMUSE0-RL-04 (2,000 ms), after which an outstanding commit is treated as ambiguous.
notes: Measured by ITEM-USE-1c (#1622) on 2026-10-13 with ITEMUSE0-RL-02 on the ITEM-USE-0 §4.4 flask shape: p99 18.8, 27.2 and 31.8 ms over three runs; the highest, rounded up, is registered. An earlier one-item Burn measurement (up to 55.3 ms) was the cheaper shape and is not the registered evidence. Not production hardware.
